description: This diagram details the Raw Water System, showing components like pumps, valves, strainers, tanks, heat exchangers, and associated piping for various subsystems, including engine room, generators, air conditioning, and watermaker. The primary flow shows raw water taken from seachests, passing through strainers and pumps, routed to heat exchangers and other consumers, and ultimately discharged overboard. Various valves are shown to isolate different branches and equipment. Detailed schedules for pipe details, bill of materials, and pump data are included.
